reviews.comment:
My husband and I were fortunate enough to find Andra when we were looking to buy a new build. Besides knowing what kind of home and community we wanted, we knew nothing about the buying process. He, on the other hand, knew about everything we didn’t.
Andra has worked in real estate for many years and his experience in various areas within the field enables him to see things through multiple lenses, giving him a holistic understanding of real estate. And with that knowledge, Andra guided us through the home buying process, from start to finish. 
Despite his busy schedule, our calls, texts and emails were always answered within 10 minutes.
We felt we were his top priority. 
And in the end, what mattered most was his negotiating skills which substantially lowered the asking price and got us appliance bonuses.   
Thank you Andra for giving it your all!

Andra is a man of his word! He said he would help me secure the property I was set on buying, and he did. He even went above and beyond by helping me negotiate the final offer and arrange inspections for me all while I was out of town for the weekend and could only communicate via texts and brief phone calls. Andra has a very energetic personality but was also patient and responsive to my wants and needs. As a first time home buyer, he made the home-buying process much easier than I had expected. I am very grateful he helped me secure my new home and would recommend him to anyone looking for a highly experienced agent who follows through with his word and is quick to respond no matter the time of day. Thank you, Andra!
Andra, will guide you thru-out the final of the transaction.
